limitations: Readiness labels concern a synthetic work on a given grade, not three-class classification of a person.
Positive independent reasoning validates task arithmetic/content boundaries, not human difficulty.
A/B profile disagreement is deliberately retained for template-specific ability; it does not establish stochastic repeat reliability.
Fresh-control uses new parameters and independent worked answers, but shares semantic templates with development.
Threshold sensitivity is descriptive; production thresholds were never tuned against this report.

Core method transfer uses a bounded source-signature-validated model on visible new calls. Five non-core slots are independently correct by construction, so this is a conditional core-mechanism experiment, not acquired full-form skill.

Source definitions must match exact declared text after CRLF normalization and outer trim; all internal indentation/whitespace/literals remain significant. Alternative source formatting is conservatively unsupported, not semantically inferred.
Only source mechanism maps declared in model provenance are evaluated. Unsupported/count-mismatched scenarios are not_evaluated, not evidence of resistance.
Independent-understanding strategy is a declared target-reference positive control, not observed human understanding or a simulated learning process.
Historical v1 transfer reports contain two empty Backend model answers and a constant Frontend fallback; their broad transfer interpretation is invalid, preserved as history, and superseded by v2.
